classificationVocabulary.external-runtime-or-foreign-input: The field is authored across a runtime boundary, by a user/config/plugin/SDK, or by a foreign file format. An in-repo object-literal producer is neither expected nor required.
classificationVocabulary.deliberate-reserved-or-passthrough: The field deliberately preserves a future, compatibility, or passthrough shape even though the current product does not write it.
classificationVocabulary.proven-live-flow-missed-by-lens: A live in-repo producer and consumer exist, but the lens misses the flow because it is dynamically assembled, computed, spread, or otherwise not an explicit type-resolved object-property write.
classificationVocabulary.genuine-unwired-dead-candidate: No legitimate external author, producer, consumer, or reserved contract was found; deletion-grade scans are required before recommending removal.
classificationVocabulary.tool-false-positive-or-coverage-limitati: The finding is caused by a known evidence-plane limitation and does not establish field death.

toolBehaviorConclusions: The snapshot's name-matched consumer evidence is useful for locating reads, but it is not type-resolved flow proof and must not drive deletion by itself.

Boundary schemas naturally have no in-repo producer: users, imported files, plugin manifests/specs, and SDK responses populate them. The lens should classify these declaration homes as boundary inputs rather than implying they need an internal writer.

Type/schema twins produce duplicate lifecycle findings for one wire field, as shown by $state, tiles, filters, and enumValues. A useful report should pair those twins before counting remediation candidates.

QuickJS host APIs are assembled with ctx.newFunction/ctx.setProp. PluginHostV1 member declarations therefore require dynamic-property evidence; an object-literal-only producer model falsely marks live host functions and namespaces declared-only.

Computed property construction defeats field spelling. stats-delta.ts deterministically generates the eight daily/model sample keys in tokenSampleSlice and consumers read them explicitly; this is a concrete positive control for computed-key producer coverage.

Whole-object forwarding/spreads also obscure nested fields. World-info span is accepted as one typed object and spread into provenance, while the lens reports fromSeq/toSeq individually as unpopulated.
Reserved fields require code-law context. temperatureC is deliberately part of the future full-engine storage shape and the reachability suite explicitly asserts that lite cannot write it.

literalAndSourceReview.method: Read source control flow and used rg name searches only as corroboration; same-spelled unrelated fields were not treated as type-resolved evidence.

limitations: This is an adjudication of the supplied 48-item snapshot, not a fresh AST execution.

External producer behavior is evidenced by boundary contracts and focused fixtures; this lane did not execute foreign SDKs, plugin bundles, or import UIs.
